info.name: Declut API
info.description:
Declut — escrow marketplace API for pre-owned household items. NestJS + MongoDB.

Folders mirror the URL path: each path segment is a folder, each :param is a {paramName} folder, and the request sits inside the deepest folder.

Run auth → register or auth → login first (auto-saves accessToken/refreshToken). Admin routes need a separate token from admin → auth → login (a regular-admin token never works on /admin/*, and vice versa). baseUrl defaults to http://localhost:3000/api.

request.description: Sends a 6-digit email verification OTP. Response includes emailVerified and kycStatus. pushToken is optional — if present, added to deviceTokens (deduped, same as POST /notifications/register-token).

identifier is email or phone. Logging in elsewhere invalidates the previous refresh token (one active session at a time). pushToken is optional — if present, added to deviceTokens (deduped, same as POST /notifications/register-token).
Flips emailVerified to true. Required before KYC.
Rotates the token pair; the old refresh token stops working.
Same response whether or not the email exists.
Returns a resetToken on success.
All fields optional. Bank details are required to receive a payout.

request.description: filter: thisMonth|lastMonth|last3Months|thisYear|custom (custom requires startDate+endDate). 8 cards, each {value, extra: {status, result}} (status is "productive" or "warning"): numberOfUsers, newListings, transactionsToday, completedTransactions, revenue, escrowBalance, pendingInspections, openDisputes. numberOfUsers/newListings/transactionsToday/completedTransactions.value/revenue scope to the selected filter (extra compares vs the prior period). escrowBalance/pendingInspections/openDisputes are live, filter-independent snapshots ("what needs attention right now") — escrowBalance sums amount currently held in escrow_active/awaiting_inspection transactions, pendingInspections.extra counts those within 6h of their inspection deadline, openDisputes.extra counts disputes past the stalled-threshold SLA. completedTransactions.extra is an all-time success rate (completed ÷ all finished-outcome transactions), not period-scoped.

query.description: Calendar year, 2000-2100. Default the current year.

request.description: Always Jan-Dec of the given year, zero-filled. Each trend entry carries both grossRevenue (summed transaction amount) and commissionAmount (platform earnings) for that month. insights: twelveMonthGross/bestMonth/avgPerMonth are derived from trend[].grossRevenue, short-form Naira; totalRemittance (grossRevenue minus commissionAmount, summed) is full, non-abbreviated Naira.

totalListingsValue: all-time sum of listing.price across every non-deleted listing. trend: last 6 months (5 back + current), zero-filled, each { month, totalListing, listingWorth } — totalListing is a count of listings created that month, listingWorth is that month's summed listing.price.
Top 5 categories by number of COMPLETED transactions. Each entry: category, slug, transactionCount, percentage (share of all completed transactions), amount (gross transaction value, not commission).

The 3 most recent AuditLog entries, newest first, actor resolved to a display name (or "System"). Returns the structured event (event, entityType, entityId, oldState, newState, metadata) — not a prebuilt narrative sentence.

All-time donut data. total = completed + awaitingInspection + disputed + cancelled counts (pending_payment/escrow_active/stalled/refunded are excluded — still in-progress or already surfaced elsewhere). Each of the 4 buckets: { count, percentage } (percentage is share of total, one decimal).

Every admin must be assigned a Role at creation (roleId) — access comes entirely from that Role's permissions, not from anything on the admin itself. title is a free-text job label, not a role. Sends an invite email to the new sub-admin with their email, password, and a link to the admin portal login page — a failed/unconfigured send does not fail the creation itself.
Reassigns which Role this admin is attached to — access itself lives on the Role (see the roles folder), not on the admin. Replaces the old per-admin permissions-edit endpoint.

Verifies the email against the Admin collection first. 404s with "No admin account found with that email address" if it doesn't match; otherwise emails a reset link (ADMIN_APP_URL/reset-password/{token}) and returns "Password reset link sent to {email}".
Paste the token from the emailed reset link (or the dev-environment server log, since Brevo isn't configured) into adminResetToken first.
token now travels as a URL param, matching the emailed reset link's own shape.
confirmNewPassword must match newPassword (400 otherwise). Sets passwordChangedAt, returned on GET /admin/auth/me.
A named, reusable bundle of privileges — every module defaults to {view:false,write:false,delete:false} unless overridden. name must be unique.
Every role, newest first. Now paginated (page/limit) — no date-range filtering here (excluded on instruction). userCount is computed live (how many admins currently point at each role), not stored.
Partial patch — a module/action left out of permissions keeps its current value, it isn't reset to false. name is optional too.
Blocked with 409 if any admin is still assigned to this role — reassign them first (PATCH .../sub-admins/{id}/role).
